categories: ["Topic: Combine", "Position: By position group", "Population: Combine invitees", "Figure: Line chart"]

---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
combine <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "combine") |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(combine_position_group(pos), pos_levels))
combine_years <- range(combine$season)
combine_span <- paste0(combine_years[1], " to ", combine_years[2], " combines")
sep_levels <- setdiff(pos_levels, "Special teams")
claim_fill <- "#374151"
context_fill <- "#9CA3AF"
# 2021 was cancelled, and its records are campus pro-day workouts (pro-day-year).
pro_day_year <- 2021L
# The first five combines against the last five, skipping the cancelled year.
combine_seasons <- setdiff(sort(unique(combine$season)), pro_day_year)
early_window <- head(combine_seasons, 5L)
late_window <- tail(combine_seasons, 5L)
early_label <- paste0(min(early_window), " to ", max(early_window))
late_label <- paste0(min(late_window), " to ", max(late_window))

drift <- combine |>
  filter(season %in% c(early_window, late_window), position_group %in% sep_levels) |>
  mutate(window = if_else(season %in% early_window, "first", "last")) |>
  group_by(position_group, window) |>
  summarise(
    ran = mean(!is.na(forty)),
    forty = stats::median(forty, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = c(forty, ran)) |>
  mutate(forty_change = forty_last - forty_first)
# The position whose median time fell the most is the highlight.
biggest_drop <- drift |> slice_min(forty_change, n = 1)
medians_season <- combine |>
  filter(!is.na(forty), position_group %in% sep_levels) |>
  group_by(position_group, season) |>
  summarise(med = stats::median(forty), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- drift |>
  mutate(
    is_claim = position_group == biggest_drop$position_group,
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: median %.2f s to %.2f s; ran the drill, %.0f%% to %.0f%%",
      position_group,
      forty_first,
      forty_last,
      100 * ran_first,
      100 * ran_last
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = forcats::fct_rev(position_group))) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = forty_first, xend = forty_last, colour = is_claim),
    linewidth = 1.4,
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(x = forty_first, tooltip = tip, data_id = position_group),
    size = 4,
    colour = "#6B7280"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = context_fill, `TRUE` = claim_fill), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Did the median forty-yard dash get faster at every position?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Median in ",
      early_label,
      " to median in ",
      late_label,
      "; largest drop in dark grey"
    ),
    x = "Median forty (s); 2021 left out",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "forty-yard-dash-drift", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-season
p_season <- medians_season |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf("%s, %s: median %.2f s (%d invitees)", position_group, season, med, n)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(season, med, colour = position_group, group = position_group)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = pro_day_year - 0.5,
    xmax = pro_day_year + 0.5,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, season)), size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_position() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(combine_years[1], combine_years[2], 4)) +
  labs(
    title = "The median forty-yard dash, combine by combine",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "One line per position group, ",
      combine_span,
      "; a shorter time is faster"
    ),
    x = "Combine year (shaded 2021: pro-day data)",
    y = "Median forty-yard dash (s)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_season, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```
